title: Ritual walkthrough
description: A guided, explanatory walkthrough of a documented practice, played by framework/engine/sequence-engine.js. It shows what a practice involves and what its tradition says it means; it is not a game and never scores the visitor. The engine reads only the five step fields marked ENGINE; everything else is for people (display, review, sourcing).

id.description: Registry ID, ritual:<slug>; the file is data/rituals/<slug>.json.

tradition.description: The tradition whose practice this is, in plain words. Data only: the engine never sees it.

chapter.description: The chapter the practice belongs to.

sensitivity_tier.description: 1 = may be drafted and built without asking (widely shared, explanatory, nothing sacramental). 2 = historical or contested practice; drafted only with framing reviewed by Carter. 3 = sacramental or obligatory worship (Mass, communion, baptism, salat…); never drafted without Carter's explicit approval, listed in plans/rituals-tiers.md.

framing.const: guided, explanatory, no scores or win states
framing.description: Fixed wording. A file with any other framing fails validation.

opt_in.description: A walkthrough only ever starts when the visitor chooses it.

intro.description: Shown before step 1: what this is, and that it is an explanation, not an act of worship by the visitor.

checked.description: How and when the source was confirmed (e.g. 'search result 2026-10-11; page blocked from the build sandbox, re-read at review').

sequence_order.description: ENGINE. 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats.

pacing_duration_ms.description: ENGINE. How long the step holds before it may move on. A display choice unless a source gives a timing; say which in 'pacing_note'.

input_trigger_type.description: ENGINE. auto: advance when the time runs out. tap: wait for the visitor (time is the minimum). hold: advance once the visitor has held for the duration.

historical_text_anchor_id.description: ENGINE. The chapter section that discusses this step, or null when no chapter covers it yet (a content gap, recorded in 'anchor_gap').

source_ids.description: ENGINE. IDs from this file's sources[] that support the step.

text.description: What the visitor reads. Descriptive voice ('In the sutta, the practitioner…'), never an instruction to worship.

status.description: Drafts are not shown anywhere. Only Carter moves a ritual to cleared.
